title: The IRS Credit Worth $7,830 That 5M Workers Skip
hook: The IRS has a credit worth up to $7,830 that millions of qualifying workers never claim — because nobody tells you it exists.
angle: The EITC is refundable — you get a check even if you owe zero in taxes — but 5 million eligible workers skip it every year because it's buried and the IRS never reminds you
audience: Low-to-moderate income workers, gig workers, part-timers, recently divorced people, and anyone who has never heard of the Earned Income Tax Credit
key_numbers: Eligible workers who skip it: ~5 million per year (about 20%)
Income limit: up to $59,899 for families with 3+ children
Unclaimed EITC nationally: billions left on the table annually
